sources.title: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio: qwen3.8-max
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The current Max documentation, updated October 11, calls it a 2.4-trillion-parameter MoE and explicitly identifies qwen3.8-max-0902 (alias qwen3.8-max-2026-09-02) as an upgraded snapshot of qwen3.8-max. Its native vision is described as refined; no pruning, distillation, expert expansion or added modality is disclosed. The snapshot retains a 1,000,000-token context.

sources.title: [Model Studio] Update Notice for Qwen3.8-Max Models
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The September 2 developer notice explicitly names 0902 as the September 2, 2026 snapshot of Qwen3.8-Max and maps the moving qwen3.8-max endpoint to it from September 5. Changes concern coding, agentic collaboration and refined visual understanding; the context, thinking mode and tool ecosystem are retained. It does not separately restate parameter counts.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Release tables explicitly date qwen3.8-max-0902 to September 2, 2026, including Singapore, Beijing and global scopes. This is release evidence independent of the model-name suffix.

sources.title: Alibaba Unveils Qwen3.8-Max: Its Largest and Most Capable Flagship Model to Date
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The August 3 developer launch release directly describes hosted multimodal Qwen3.8-Max as having 2.4 trillion total parameters and 95 billion activated parameters, with sparse MoE and hybrid attention. These are nominal model-level disclosures, not counts restricted to the later open text checkpoint. The named 0902 snapshot relationship is established separately by s1/s2/s7.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, including the raw README. The open checkpoint is a text-only causal language model requiring thinking, with 2.4T total and 95B active listed under Language Model. The card calls hosted Qwen3.8-Max its official version with added vision, optional thinking and tools. This component-specific table alone does not establish a complete hosted-model count; s4 and s10 independently publish nominal counts for hosted Max.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio: PDF understanding
sources.evidence: Updated October 23. Explicitly lists qwen3.8-max-0902 among models accepting PDFs by URL or Base64 in Beijing and Singapore. PDF input is unsupported through the Responses API.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Max-0902 - QwenCloud
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The exact qwen3.8-max-0902 page calls it an upgraded snapshot of qwen3.8-max, provides the long-date alias, and describes improved coding, agent coordination and refined native visual understanding. Thinking, function calling and 1M context are retained. No structural parameter-count change is disclosed.

sources.evidence: Classifies qwen3.8-max-0902 under Qwen Max and separately identifies qwen3.8-2.4t-a95b and qwen3.8-27b as Qwen Open-source models.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Max: A New Bar for Coding and Cowork
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved through indexed primary-page content October 27; direct page extraction is empty. The August 3 official release describes Qwen3.8-Max available via QwenCloud and explicitly lists 2.4T parameters with 95B active. Its multimodal discussion covers native vision, documents and video. The count is a nominal hosted-Max model specification, not a tensor census or solely an open-checkpoint language-model table.

license.note: No exact weight artifact and corresponding license were verified for this hosted variant. API terms and other checkpoint or companion-software licenses do not establish a weight license here.

parameters_b.note: Alibaba and Qwen directly publish a nominal 2.4T total for hosted multimodal Qwen3.8-Max. Current documentation repeats 2.4T and names 0902 as its upgraded snapshot; the update notice explicitly maps the endpoint. This is the developer nominal model size, without an invented vision-component adjustment.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal lineage inference: Qwen and Alibaba publish 95B active for hosted Qwen3.8-Max, and developer documentation explicitly identifies 0902 as its upgraded snapshot. The update refines existing coding, agent and native-vision capabilities; no structural parameter-count change is disclosed. The 0902 pages do not independently repeat 95B. This inference uses the hosted-Max release, not the separate text-only checkpoint.

architecture.note: Current Max documentation states MoE; the explicit alias transition links it to 0902. No layer or expert counts are inferred from the separate checkpoint.

context_window.note: Exact snapshot context limit is 1,000,000 tokens. Its 991,808-token maximum input is a separate limit.

modalities.note: Snapshot capability table confirms text/image/video to text; dedicated PDF documentation explicitly includes 0902, subject to region and API restrictions.

reasoning.note: Exact snapshot supports thinking mode, with an enable_thinking API example.

tool_call.note: Function calling is explicitly supported for this snapshot.

Qwen hosted Max nominal total and active parameters

patch.notes: Alibaba publishes a nominal 2.4T total and 95B active for hosted Qwen3.8-Max. The 95B active count is inherited by inference from the developer-documented 0902 snapshot relationship; no structural change is disclosed. PDF input is supported in Beijing/Singapore through Chat Completions, not Responses. Exact weight-release status and a corresponding weight license remain unverified.

summary: Fresh parameter review retains the nominal 2400B total and establishes 95B active by a clearly labeled lineage inference from the hosted Qwen3.8-Max release to its developer-documented 0902 snapshot. Reopened current specifications, the snapshot update notice, exact snapshot page, launch release and open model card, and retrieved the official Qwen release. The hosted release independently supplies both counts, so no language-backbone-only scope is imposed from the separate open checkpoint. No structural-change disclosure was found; 0902 does not separately restate its active count. All unrelated field assessments are preserved.

parameter_reaudit.outcome: Verified nominal 2400B total and 95B active; active count is an explicit named-snapshot lineage inference from hosted Qwen3.8-Max.
parameter_reaudit.evidence_note: Fresh searches covered Qwen, Alibaba Cloud and the exact 0902 identifier for total/active parameters, post-training and vision scope. Secondary post-training reports served only as leads; the accepted counts rely on developer sources. No later first-party 0902 active-count table or disclosed structural change was found.
